# CLI Reference

- `tidewatch fleet status`: show agent versions and error rates per vessel.
- `tidewatch fleet rollback`: return all gateways to the previous release.
- `tidewatch keys rotate --scope <scope>`: issue a replacement key.
- `tidewatch replay --from <timestamp>`: re-send dead-lettered messages from a point in time.
